name: Logger++
author: Corey Arthur, Soroush Dalili (NCC Group)
description: Advanced, filterable logging of HTTP requests/responses across all the host suite tools, with a powerful grid, filters and export.

name: Hackvertor
author: community (public catalog)
description: Tag-based conversion of text: encode/decode, hashing, encryption and custom transforms, usable inline in requests.

name: JWT Editor
author: Fraser Winterborn (BlackBerry)
description: Inspect, edit, sign and verify JSON Web Tokens and JWKs; attack weak signing and key-confusion issues.

name: Param Miner
author: community (public catalog)
description: Discovers hidden, unlinked request parameters and headers; useful for cache poisoning and hidden functionality.

name: Turbo Intruder
author: community (public catalog)
description: Sends very large numbers of HTTP requests with fine-grained, scriptable scheduling; good for race conditions.

name: Autorize
author: Barak Tawily
description: Automatically tests for authorization flaws by replaying requests with a low-privilege session and comparing responses.

name: ActiveScan++
author: community (public catalog)
description: Extends the active/passive scanner with extra checks (host header attacks, injection variants, etc.).

name: Retire.js
author: Philippe Arteau
description: Passively flags use of JavaScript libraries with known vulnerabilities, based on the retire.js dataset.
